from scipy._lib.deprecation import _sub_module_deprecation


__all__ = ["gaussian_kde"]  # noqa: F822


def __dir__():
    return __all__


def __getattr__(name):
    return _sub_module_deprecation(sub_package="stats", module="kde",
                                   private_modules=["_kde"], all=__all__,
                                   attribute=name)
